sample_unit: patients with choroidal melanocytic lesions (388 fundus images total)
models_evaluated: in-house AI classifier for choroidal melanocytic lesions in colour fundus images

links.outcome: Association of lesion characteristics, demographics and risk factors with false-negative AI classifications
links.effect: 44 of 194 lesion eyes (23%) were false negatives. Thinner lesions were more often missed (p = 0.026). Imaging risk factors for uveal melanoma showed no significant association with false negatives.
links.quote: Thinner lesions were more likely to be missed by the model (p = 0.026), resulting in a FN classification.

unlisted_practices: Analyzing clinical features associated with false-negative classifications to improve interpretability of an imaging AI model

screen.reason: The study conducts an error/subgroup analysis to evaluate clinical variables associated with false-negative predictions of an ophthalmic AI model, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
